title: Query count unchanged by relabelling outputs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$, $\alpha$, and $\beta$ be types, let $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $g:\alpha\to\beta$. For any finite decision tree $T$ with available set $A$ and any input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, replacing each leaf label $a$ by $g(a)$ does not change the number of queries made on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with available set $A$
